answer: Splitting into 2 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded quill account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the pearl binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The orchard explorer reveals the whole merge tree. The bill scales 39 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
